data.body: RED (AC1): with the new `tests/unit/test_git_ssh_output_encoding.py` in place and `src/` still at origin/main 1654f3e3e53, `pytest tests/unit/test_git_ssh_output_encoding.py` gives 5 failed, 1 passed. The failures are `test_run_git_decodes_a_non_ascii_subject[subprocess-run]`, `[process-group]`, `test_run_git_encodes_str_stdin_as_utf8[subprocess-run]`, `[process-group]` and `test_ssh_keygen_version_probe_names_its_encoding`. In each, the child's stderr ends with `EncodingWarning: 'encoding' argument not specified.` raised from `subprocess._text_encoding`. `test_run_git_binary_mode_stays_binary` passes pre-fix, as planned.
